description_zh: 调用该接口修改指定的规则动作
name: UpdateRuleAction

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or an </ph></props>ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule action to be modified.

After you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html operation to create a rule action, the ID of the rule action is returned. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html operation to view the ID of the rule action in the returned result
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的规则动作ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html创建规则动作成功后，返回的规则动作ID，您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html，从返回结果中查看对应的规则动作ID
parameters.name: action_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule action. Valid values:

<props="china">- DATAHUB: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for streaming data processing.</props>
<props="china">- ONS: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.</props>
MNS: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to Message Service for message transmission.
FC: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to Function Compute for event-driven computing.
REPUBLISH: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to another IoT Platform topic.
AMQP: forwards data to an AMQP consumer group.
OTS: forwards the topic data processed by the rule to Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

Rules whose data format is binary (that is, the DataType parameter of the rule is set to BINARY) do not support forwarding data to Tablestore.
The destination cloud services to which the rules engine can forward data vary based on the region. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85669.html supported by the rules engine
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作类型，取值：

<props="china">- DATAHUB：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。</props>
<props="china">- ONS：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。</props>
MNS：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
FC：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
REPUBLISH：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至另一个物联网平台 Topic。
AMQP：数据流转到AMQP消费组。
OTS：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云表格存储，进行NoSQL数据存储。

数据格式为二进制的规则（即规则的DataType参数是BINARY）不支持转发数据至OTS（表格存储）。
服务地域不同，规则引擎所支持的数据转发目标云产品不同。具体请参见规则引擎相关https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85669.html
